hook.en: In June 1948, three European planters were shot dead at Sungai Siput, Perak. For the next twelve years, villagers lived behind barbed wire and carried ID cards everywhere. Why was the threat so serious?
hook.bm: Pada Jun 1948, tiga pengurus ladang Eropah ditembak mati di Sungai Siput, Perak. Selama dua belas tahun berikutnya, penduduk kampung tinggal di sebalik kawat berduri dan membawa kad pengenalan ke mana-mana. Mengapakah ancaman itu begitu serius?

bigIdeas.en: The Communist Party of Malaya (PKM, 1930) wanted to set up a communist republic by force.
bigIdeas.bm: Parti Komunis Malaya (PKM, 1930) mahu menubuhkan republik komunis secara kekerasan.

bigIdeas.en: After the Sungai Siput killings in June 1948, an Emergency was declared; it lasted until 1960.
bigIdeas.bm: Selepas pembunuhan di Sungai Siput pada Jun 1948, Darurat diisytiharkan; ia berlanjutan hingga 1960.

bigIdeas.en: The Briggs Plan, "hearts and minds" under Templer and the people's cooperation defeated the communists.
bigIdeas.bm: Rancangan Briggs, dasar "memenangi hati dan fikiran rakyat" Templer serta kerjasama rakyat mengalahkan komunis.

definition.en: Parti Komunis Malaya (Communist Party of Malaya), founded 1930.
Period of special laws to fight the communist threat, 1948–1960.
definition.bm: Tempoh undang-undang khas untuk memerangi ancaman komunis, 1948–1960.

definition.en: 1950 plan to cut communist supplies by moving squatters into New Villages.
definition.bm: Rancangan 1950 untuk memutuskan bekalan komunis dengan memindahkan setinggan ke Kampung Baru.

definition.en: Guarded settlement with fences, where squatters were resettled.
definition.bm: Penempatan berkawal dan berpagar untuk setinggan yang dipindahkan.

definition.en: Area declared free of communists; restrictions lifted (first: Melaka, 1953).
definition.bm: Kawasan yang diisytiharkan bebas komunis; sekatan ditarik balik (pertama: Melaka, 1953).

definition.en: Templer's approach of winning public support through development and trust.
definition.bm: Pendekatan Templer meraih sokongan rakyat melalui pembangunan dan kepercayaan.

question.en: Explain TWO steps taken by the government to defeat the communists. (4 marks)
question.bm: Jelaskan DUA langkah kerajaan untuk mengalahkan komunis. (4 markah)

steps.en: Step 1: Briggs Plan — squatters moved to New Villages to cut food and information to the communists.
steps.bm: Langkah 1: Rancangan Briggs — setinggan dipindahkan ke Kampung Baru untuk memutuskan bekalan makanan dan maklumat kepada komunis.

steps.en: Step 2: Templer's "hearts and minds" — development, citizenship and trust to win the people's support.
steps.bm: Langkah 2: "Hati dan fikiran" Templer — pembangunan, kerakyatan dan kepercayaan untuk meraih sokongan rakyat.

answer.en: Other accepted points: identity cards, Home Guard, White Areas, rewards for surrender.
answer.bm: Isi lain yang diterima: kad pengenalan, Home Guard, Kawasan Putih, ganjaran untuk menyerah diri.

prompt.en: The Communist Party of Malaya (PKM) was founded in…
prompt.bm: Parti Komunis Malaya (PKM) ditubuhkan pada…

prompt.en: What was the main aim of the PKM?
prompt.bm: Apakah matlamat utama PKM?

explanation.en: PKM wanted a communist state through armed struggle.
explanation.bm: PKM mahukan negara komunis melalui perjuangan bersenjata.

options.en: To set up a communist republic

prompt.en: The Emergency was declared after three European planters were killed at…
prompt.bm: Darurat diisytiharkan selepas tiga pengurus ladang Eropah dibunuh di…

explanation.en: The killings at Sungai Siput in June 1948 led to the declaration.
explanation.bm: Pembunuhan di Sungai Siput pada Jun 1948 membawa kepada perisytiharan Darurat.

prompt.en: The Emergency lasted from…
prompt.bm: Darurat berlangsung dari…

explanation.en: Declared in 1948, it officially ended on 31 July 1960.
explanation.bm: Diisytiharkan pada 1948, ia tamat secara rasmi pada 31 Julai 1960.

prompt.en: Which High Commissioner was killed by communists at Fraser's Hill in 1951?
prompt.bm: Pesuruhjaya Tinggi manakah dibunuh komunis di Bukit Fraser pada 1951?

prompt.en: Arrange these Emergency events in time order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa Darurat ini mengikut kronologi.

prompt.en: Which communist attack on a police station in 1950 is remembered for great bravery?
prompt.bm: Serangan komunis ke atas balai polis manakah pada 1950 dikenang kerana keberanian luar biasa?

explanation.en: On 23 February 1950, police and villagers at Bukit Kepong, Johor, fought to the end.
explanation.bm: Pada 23 Februari 1950, anggota polis dan penduduk di Bukit Kepong, Johor, berjuang hingga ke titisan darah terakhir.

prompt.en: What does the sacrifice at Bukit Kepong teach young Malaysians?
prompt.bm: Apakah pengajaran pengorbanan di Bukit Kepong kepada generasi muda Malaysia?

explanation.en: The defenders chose to fight rather than surrender.
explanation.bm: Para pertahanan memilih untuk berjuang daripada menyerah.

options.en: Loyalty and courage in defending the nation

prompt.en: Why did the government call it an "Emergency" rather than a "war"?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah kerajaan memanggilnya "Darurat" dan bukan "perang"?

explanation.en: Insurers in London would not cover losses caused by "war".
explanation.bm: Syarikat insurans di London tidak menanggung kerugian akibat "perang".

options.en: So insurance for estates and mines remained valid and trade could continue
options.bm: Supaya insurans ladang dan lombong kekal sah dan perdagangan boleh diteruskan

prompt.en: The 1950 plan to move squatters into New Villages was the ______ Plan.
prompt.bm: Rancangan 1950 untuk memindahkan setinggan ke Kampung Baru ialah Rancangan ______.

explanation.en: Lt-Gen Sir Harold Briggs designed it.
explanation.bm: Leftenan Jeneral Sir Harold Briggs merangkanya.

prompt.en: The first "White Area" was declared in 1953 in…
prompt.bm: "Kawasan Putih" pertama diisytiharkan pada 1953 di…

explanation.en: Melaka became the first White Area, free of communists.
explanation.bm: Melaka menjadi Kawasan Putih pertama, bebas daripada komunis.

prompt.en: Templer's approach was called winning the hearts and ______ of the people.
prompt.bm: Pendekatan Templer dipanggil memenangi hati dan ______ rakyat.

explanation.en: "Hearts and minds" focused on trust and development.
explanation.bm: "Hati dan fikiran" memberi tumpuan kepada kepercayaan dan pembangunan.

prompt.en: Select ALL measures used during the Emergency.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA langkah yang digunakan semasa Darurat.

explanation.en: The Malayan Union had ended in 1948 and was not an Emergency measure.
explanation.bm: Malayan Union sudah tamat pada 1948 dan bukan langkah Darurat.

prompt.en: Why were squatters moved into New Villages?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah setinggan dipindahkan ke Kampung Baru?

explanation.en: Many squatters near the jungle had been forced to supply the communists (Min Yuen network).
explanation.bm: Ramai setinggan di pinggir hutan dipaksa membekalkan komunis (rangkaian Min Yuen).

options.en: To cut off food, money and information to the communists
options.bm: Untuk memutuskan bekalan makanan, wang dan maklumat kepada komunis

options.en: To give them better farms only
options.bm: Untuk memberi ladang yang lebih baik sahaja

prompt.en: The Baling Talks (December 1955) were between Tunku Abdul Rahman and…
prompt.bm: Rundingan Baling (Disember 1955) diadakan antara Tunku Abdul Rahman dan…

explanation.en: Chin Peng led the PKM. The talks failed because he refused to surrender unconditionally.
explanation.bm: Chin Peng memimpin PKM. Rundingan gagal kerana beliau enggan menyerah tanpa syarat.

prompt.en: Why did the Baling Talks fail?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah Rundingan Baling gagal?

explanation.en: Tunku insisted on surrender; Chin Peng refused.
explanation.bm: Tunku menegaskan penyerahan diri; Chin Peng enggan.

options.en: The PKM refused to surrender and wanted to be recognised as a legal party
options.bm: PKM enggan menyerah dan mahu diiktiraf sebagai parti sah

prompt.en: Match each person with his role.
prompt.bm: Padankan tokoh dengan peranannya.

explanation.en: Each leader shaped a different stage of the Emergency.
explanation.bm: Setiap tokoh mempengaruhi peringkat Darurat yang berbeza.

prompt.en: Why was "hearts and minds" more effective than force alone?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah dasar "hati dan fikiran" lebih berkesan daripada kekerasan semata-mata?

explanation.en: Without public support, guerrillas lose food, recruits and hiding places.
explanation.bm: Tanpa sokongan rakyat, gerila kehilangan makanan, anggota baharu dan tempat persembunyian.

options.en: People who trust the government give information and stop helping the communists
options.bm: Rakyat yang percaya kepada kerajaan memberi maklumat dan berhenti membantu komunis

prompt.en: Which was an effect of the Emergency on the economy?
prompt.bm: Apakah kesan Darurat terhadap ekonomi?

explanation.en: Money went to defence, and attacks disrupted rubber and tin production.
explanation.bm: Wang disalurkan untuk pertahanan, dan serangan mengganggu pengeluaran getah dan bijih timah.

options.en: High spending on security and damage to estates and mines
options.bm: Perbelanjaan keselamatan yang tinggi dan kerosakan ladang dan lombong

options.en: Independence came sooner because of profits

prompt.en: How did the Emergency help speed up independence?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah Darurat membantu mempercepat kemerdekaan?

explanation.en: Granting independence took away the communists' main argument that they were fighting colonialism.
explanation.bm: Pemberian kemerdekaan melemahkan hujah utama komunis bahawa mereka melawan penjajah.

options.en: The British realised that winning support needed local leaders and self-government
options.bm: British sedar bahawa sokongan rakyat memerlukan pemimpin tempatan dan pemerintahan sendiri

options.en: It made Malaya a colony of Japan
